title: Prove promoted ATLAS-WP-025 seam merge after historical router false negative
purpose: Close the already-authorized ATLAS-WP-025 promotion cleanly by independently proving the exact accepted seam merge topology, promoted blob identity, repaired learner-safe UI boundary, accepted artifact identity and learner-journey regressions after the generic historical Wave A post-merge router produced a false negative. The product merge is already historical and immutable, so this work package adds a bounded recovery verifier instead of permanent one-off routing code.
invariants: Only the dedicated recovery verifier and CI-WP-016 metadata change.
The verifier is bound to historical promotion merge 55378d4d361c864ce3d0969a1c4f219451e9416b and accepted PR head 0888192c90698a1acf73e4ec59616c9d763131be.
The promotion requires exactly two parents and accepted second parent 0888192c90698a1acf73e4ec59616c9d763131be.
The exact first-parent delta is the six paths carried by promoted PR #365.
Every promoted path blob at merge HEAD equals the accepted PR-head blob.
The verifier reruns the causal learner-safe secret-boundary proof plus qcm/fill, Atlas core, learning, experience, integration and UX-clarity regressions against the merge tree.
Both accepted PR head and promotion merge rebuild to exactly 422812 bytes with SHA-256 27c462f4bab4e9fe8d6451950b51564c4676ff9b1c6da49a142770b35b6cbbdc.
The historical failed generic Wave A run remains evidence of a CI topology false negative and is not rewritten or hidden.
requiredEvidence: Dedicated recovery verifier PASS on the pull-request head.
Historical merge 55378d4d361c864ce3d0969a1c4f219451e9416b has the exact expected six-path first-parent delta and accepted second parent.
Every promoted path blob equals the accepted PR-head blob.
The causal secret-boundary proof reports UX_SECRET_BOUNDARY_PROVEN on the promotion merge tree.
The exact repaired seam regression suite passes against the historical promotion merge tree.
Accepted head and promotion merge artifacts are both byte-identical to the qualified repaired identity.
After CI-WP-016 merge, the dedicated recovery verifier passes again from main without modifying product semantics.
adversarialTests: Wrong accepted second parent fails the verifier.
Missing or extra promoted path fails exact path-set comparison.
Any scoring-secret field crossing the learner-safe UI projection fails the causal seam test.
Accepted artifact byte or SHA mismatch fails closed.
Promotion merge artifact byte or SHA mismatch fails closed.
Any qcm/fill or Atlas learner-journey regression fails the verifier.
nonGoals: Changing product code or the promoted ATLAS-WP-025 seam behavior.
Changing the central Learn-it Next router for a promotion that has already happened.
Changing planner, scoring, evidence, memory, session semantics, kits or contracts.
General redesign of the CI topology.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate this exact two-file CI-only recovery change.
The exact-head repaired seam qualification and UX PASS remain the product-semantic authorities; this verifier only reconciles the historical post-merge CI false negative.
The post-merge generic run demonstrably routed the unrecognized six-path seam merge to legacy Wave A while repository governance passed, so recovery must not reopen product semantics.
rollback: Revert the CI-WP-016 two-file recovery verifier. The promoted ATLAS-WP-025 product merge remains unchanged.
